#Chart13Input.csv: #This file contains input necessary to run the simulations required to generate Chart 13
#Chart 13 shows a time series of the flow reduction at The Dalles from the Treaty projects
#The first column contains the names of the junctions at which to save output from the simulations (typically just "The Dalles_OUT")
#Each subsequent column represents a separate simulation
#   The first row is the name of the simulation that the results will be saved as (f-part)
#   The list of projects below each column are the projects to include in the simulation. They will be operated to the "observed" operation
#   All projects not in the list will operate as they did in the unregulated simulation (typically pass inflow, but if a natural lake, then natural lake operations will be modeled)
#   The projects can be reservoir names or diversion names (separating the influence of the Upper Snake Diversions is often desired)
#All names must match the ResSim model exactly
